Package eu.algites.lib.common.documentation.model

Interface AIiDocumentationLineBreakWriteAccess

All Superinterfaces:
AIiDocumentationElement, AIiDocumentationElementWriteAccess, AIiDocumentationInlineElement, AIiDocumentationInlineElementWriteAccess, AIiDocumentationLineBreak
public interface AIiDocumentationLineBreakWriteAccess extends AIiDocumentationLineBreak, AIiDocumentationInlineElementWriteAccess
Provides write access to a line break element.

The read-only contract is defined by AIiDocumentationLineBreak. This capability interface is intended for construction, aggregation, and model-processing phases. Validators, renderers, and other read-only consumers should depend on the read-only interface instead.

This interface currently adds no type-specific write operations. It mirrors the documentation element hierarchy and inherits the write capabilities of its parent write-access interface.
